title: Что происходило в тот момент
description: Различаем длительное действие в прошлом и короткое событие, которое его прервало.
objectives: Соединить фоновое действие и событие с when
notes: Was/were + -ing описывает действие в процессе в прошлом.
Короткое событие на фоне длительного часто выражается Past Simple.

exercises.prompt: Выбери действие в процессе вчера в восемь.

options.label: I was cooking at eight yesterday.
I am cook at eight yesterday.
I were cooking at eight yesterday.

exercises.editorial_answer: I was cooking at eight yesterday.
exercises.explanation: После I в Past Continuous используется was + cooking.

exercises.prompt: Дополни предложение подходящим словом или краткой формой.

public_payload.sentence: They ___ waiting when the bus arrived.

exercises.prompt: Собери предложение о звонке во время чтения.
exercises.editorial_answer: I was reading when the phone rang.
exercises.explanation: Was reading — фон, rang — короткое событие.

public_payload.sentence: We was watching a film at nine.

accepted: We were watching a film at nine.

exercises.reference_answer: We were watching a film at nine.
exercises.incorrect_answer: We was watching a film at nine.
exercises.editorial_answer: We were watching a film at nine.

public_payload.source: Когда я пришёл домой, она спала.

accepted: She was sleeping when I came home.
When I came home, she was sleeping.

exercises.reference_answer: She was sleeping when I came home.
exercises.incorrect_answer: She sleeps when I came home.
exercises.editorial_answer: She was sleeping when I came home.
exercises.explanation: Was sleeping показывает процесс в момент возвращения.

exercises.prompt: Что Карим делал, когда погас свет?

public_payload.passage: At six yesterday, Karim was preparing dinner. His sister was doing her homework at the kitchen table. Suddenly, the lights went out. Karim stopped cooking and found a torch. His sister saved her work on her laptop, which still had battery power. They waited together until the lights came back on.

exercises.explanation: Начало текста задаёт фон: Karim was preparing dinner.

exercises.prompt: Объясни, что в тот момент был в душе.

options.label: Sorry, I have a shower every morning.
Sorry, I will buy a phone.
Sorry, I was having a shower.

lines.speaker: Friend
lines.text: Why didn't you answer my call at eight?

exercises.editorial_answer: Sorry, I was having a shower.
exercises.explanation: Was having объясняет ситуацию в конкретный прошлый момент.

public_payload.sentence: We were walking home when it suddenly ___ to rain.

exercises.explanation: Внезапное начало на фоне walking выражается Past Simple: started.
